items.title: Single-neuron encoding of rapidly learned visual information reshapes human perception
items.author: Gabriel Kreiman
items.content: The authors show that rapid learning modulates neuronal activity in the human visual cortex, requiring extra processing time to support recognition and relaying signals to memory-related regions without requiring feedback.

items.title: The human claustrum tracks uncertainty and prediction error
items.content: Single-neuron recordings provide direct evidence that the human claustrum tracks uncertainty and prediction errors during adaptive behavior. Its responses differed from those in the anterior cingulate cortex, which raises the possibility that these regions make distinct contributions to updating beliefs and guiding behavior in ever-changing environments.
